eqpack.quest.gameplay_tools_and_tips.cra: As a true expert pack, §2Druidic Quest§r features comprehensive mod integration.
This means that most recipes within the pack have been changed to include components from various mods.
Many mod mechanics have also been changed to provide balance, as well as to encourage unconventional methods of automation.
eqpack.quest.gameplay_tools_and_tips.enc: No more RNG at the enchanting table! In fact, §ono more enchanting table!§r
Enchanting is now entirely recipe-based through the powers of Ars Nouveau and Wizard's Reborn.
The accumulating xp cost on the anvil has also been removed, making armor and tool repair much more rewarding.
eqpack.quest.gameplay_tools_and_tips.equ: Armor, weapons, and tools in the pack are highly specialized. Most armor can be put together into "sets" to give additional buffs.
You'll also want to check out all the accessories available!
§2Equipping yourself appropriately for various situations could make a huge difference!§r
eqpack.quest.gameplay_tools_and_tips.exp: It's an expert pack, after all...
§2Druidic Quest§r strives to give you a wholly unique experience in Minecraft!  While you may recognize many mods included in this modpack, there is much that may surprise you along the way.
With comprehensive mod-integration enhanced by exclusive content, §2Druidic Quest§r will push you to innovate new methods of automation by mixing the powers of magic and machinery!
eqpack.quest.gameplay_tools_and_tips.inv: After typing the item you are looking for into EMI, you can double click the search bar to §6highlight§r that item in your §2inventory or opened containers§r. You can also §2hover§r over the item in your inventory or in EMI and §2press "Y"§r (by default).
Use the §2Quick Stack to Nearby Chests§r button in your inventory to quickly deposit items into nearby inventories.
You can quickly transfer items one-at-a-time between your inventory and any storage by §2scrolling§r the mouse wheel while §2hovering§r over the items you wish to move.
§2Middle-clicking§r the mouse in an inventory will §2auto-sort§r that inventory.
Annoying noises? Check out the §2Extreme Sound Muffler§r button in your inventory!
eqpack.quest.gameplay_tools_and_tips.loo: Adventure and looting are critical components of §2Druidic Quest!§r
Loot tables have been completely reworked, so don't throw away much! Everything you find is valuable in its own way.
eqpack.quest.gameplay_tools_and_tips.min: Can't find what you're looking for?
Some ore generation has been changed to enhance the progression of the pack.
Many modded ores cannot be found in the Overworld.
Check the §2EMI info§r by clicking on the ores for more details.
eqpack.quest.gameplay_tools_and_tips.pro: Meaningful progression is a major theme within §2Druidic Quest.§r Set aside the natural desire to race to power, and take time to discover all the nooks and crannies of this highly-customized world!
Quests are required for progression through the game, though they will be extremely helpful along your journey.
Rather, each new dimension is unlocked when the player obtains a specific item. With each new dimension unlocked, the mobs surrounding you will also grow more powerful.
eqpack.chapter.introduction.title: Tier 0 - Wooden Age
eqpack.quest.introduction.ancient_saplin: Growing §dancient saplings§r can help you maintain a healthy amount of aura in an area. This will prove useful later when aura-usage increases. Wood from this tree is also required for some recipes.
Read more about aura and ancient saplings in the §6Book of Natural Aura.§r
§o§7Remember, you can find saplings needed for rituals in the Market!§r§r
eqpack.quest.introduction.arcane_arts.de: Connect the arcane machinery using wissen wand . Ponder tells you more details.
You can place the blocks in any pattern you want, even placing the translator on the ceilling!
eqpack.quest.introduction.arcane_tools.d: §5Arcane Wood Tools§r are extremely slow and brittle, but have innate silk touch ability and can harvest most of the blocks.
eqpack.quest.introduction.arcanum_ore.de: §bArcanum Ore§r spawns between y90 and y-40 in the Overworld.
eqpack.quest.introduction.armour_sets.de: There's tons of armor to choose from in the pack! Most pieces are part of a set.
Sets give you bonuses for wearing 4 pieces of the same armor type.
The §eBeekeeper Set§r provides you with a few immunities to negative effects.
While the §2Cactus Set§r is the weakest option but it does provide you with thorns as well as regeneration while in the desert biomes.
eqpack.quest.introduction.assemble_the_r: Right click a stripped log with a §egold leaf§r in one hand and a §2knife§r in the other to turn it into a wooden stand.
Items used in the ritual do not need to be placed in exact order.
The tree in the middle must grow in order to obtain the result from the recipe.
§aYou will need to place a sapling and new gold powder after every recipe, so make sure to mark the position of each.§r
This pack includes custom §2ponders§r. Holding "W" while hovering over an item with an available ponder will display a schematic with an explanation on how to use it.
eqpack.quest.introduction.before_furnace: Now that you've crafted primitive tools, you can go into the real progression!
You can't yet craft a furnace to smelt ore, but you should definitely cook some food.
A nutritious and diverse diet might give you some buffs.
eqpack.quest.introduction.before_you_pun: You can sometimes find these materials laying on the ground.
If you can't find any, you can destroy leaves for a chance to drop twigs and right click stone with a empty hand to get pebbles.
§2If you dont want to chop down the whole tree you need to sneak while destroying the logs! Your first axe has very little durability, so it might not be able to chop down bigger trees.§r
eqpack.quest.introduction.brick_glue.des: Brick glue has 96 durability and uses one per brick block crafted.

eqpack.quest.introduction.craft_some_rea: While holding the wand you will be able to cast the spell imbued inside it by right clicking or pressing "Z"

eqpack.quest.introduction.different_tool: §8Flint tools§r are a faster alternative to stone tools. However, they cannot mine most ores and have -0.5 block reach compared to stone.
eqpack.quest.introduction.exploration.de: As you can see, a lot of "basic" items have changed recipes, but you can still find those items while exploring the world!
eqpack.quest.introduction.explosive_mobs: To get to the next chapter, you're gonna need to blow some stuff up.

eqpack.quest.introduction.farming.title: Farming
eqpack.quest.introduction.farming.descri: §aHoes now till blocks in 3x3 or more depending on the hoe! They do take 6 times more durability, no matter how many blocks you till. To till in an AoE you are going to need to crouch§r
Tons of crops now have uses in progression. For example, you will need to grow:
-beetroot to craft §5§lcapsids§r§r which can transport items up, as well as insert items into containers
Hoes can harvest in a 3x3 or 5x5 depending on the quality of the hoe.
Jewelry is a big part of the modpack. Putting together a good set of curios might be necessary to survive in this cruel world.
eqpack.quest.introduction.flint_knife.de: Now, modded grass variants will drop straw like vanilla grass when broken with a knife!
Harvesting crops like wheat and flax with the knife will drop straw every time.
Animals give more drops when killed with a knife. This is affected by Looting.
Drop §82 string§r, §a2 wheat seeds§r and §e4 golden flowers§r  on the ground then explode it with tnt or a creeper to craft §6Brilliant Fiber§r.
Right click the §6Brilliant Fiber§r on some leaves and wait for it to spread. Once the leaves change, they will drop §egolden leaves§r, needed for further progression.
Golden leaves are ready to harvest when you see sparkles coming out of them.
eqpack.quest.introduction.harvest_your_w: You only need a bit for now.
Though, you might as well plant some more for food.
eqpack.quest.introduction.horse_for_sale: Pro Tip: Don't look a gift horse in the mouth.
Make a one-time purchase and receive your very own sturdy steed!
eqpack.quest.introduction.important_piec: Right click to activate. When active, the eye gives +1.5 block reach for the cost of some unholy resistance and one heart.

eqpack.quest.introduction.mob_difficulty: Be sure to keep upgrading your equipment if you want to survive this cruel world! The difficulty will increase each time you obtain the appropriate materials.
eqpack.quest.introduction.new_combat_sys: But are you in a condition to fight?

eqpack.quest.introduction.new_fishing.de: Fishing is quite a bit different in this pack, thanks to the §l§3Tide§r§r mod!
eqpack.quest.introduction.potato_farming: Believe it or not, potatos are a crucial resource in the creation of machines.

eqpack.quest.introduction.primitive_mort: To craft a primitve mortar, you will need to right click a stone slab with a chisel in one hand and flint in the other.

eqpack.quest.introduction.pure_daisy.des: The Pure Daisy will convert placed logs around it (including diagonally) into arcane wood logs after 1 minute.
eqpack.quest.introduction.q49b93b2608800: Tigerseye will scare off any creepers and stop them from exploding!

eqpack.quest.spellcasting.alteration_tab: The alteration table allows you to apply threads to your magical armor. §5Threads§r provide a wide array of §5augments and effects§r, giving your armor a truly magical boost!
Placing the piece of armor on the table will give you access to its thread slots. Higher-tier slots provide greater effects.

Choose your armor wisely! The sorcerer's set gives the lowest armor value with the most thread slots, while the battlemage's set gives the highest armor value with the fewest thread slots. Check the §5Worn Notebook§r for more details!
eqpack.quest.spellcasting.annotated_code: Using the §5Annotated Codex§r will record all your known glyphs within it. If read by another player, that player will learn all the glyphs it contains. This will destroy the codex.
eqpack.quest.spellcasting.arcane_anvil.d: Combine any weapon with a scroll to §9imbue the weapon§r with that spell!
Combine §9scrolls§r with magic ink to level them up!
To make truly magical equipment, you will need this most durable of magical materials.
Find it near §9y=56§r in the Overworld, though you will need §cnetherite§r or better to harvest it...
eqpack.quest.spellcasting.blank_parchmen: The §5blank parchment§r is your access to full magical automation!
By inscribing a spell onto the parchment, you can then use the resulting §5spell scroll§r to assign a spell to spell turrets.
Using the blank parchment on a scry crystal will result in a §5bound scroll§r which can be used with the enchanter's eye.
Combining a blank parchment with the appropriate ingredients will result in an §5item scroll,§r used for managing magical automation.
eqpack.quest.spellcasting.enchanters_eye: Can be inscribed with a spell at the inscription table.

The enchanter's eye can cast spells remotely through a §5scry crystal!§r Use the eye directly on the scry crystal to set a single location, or hold a bound §5scry parchment§r in your offhand to allow for multiple locations.
The enchanter's eye will cast the inscribed spell through the scry crystal, similar to a spell turret, though the spell is considered to have been cast directly by the player when using the eye.
eqpack.quest.spellcasting.enchanters_mir: Can be inscribed with a spell at the inscription table.
The enchanter's mirror always casts §5self§r as it's initial form. When building your spell, simply continue from this point, adding §nonly§r effects and augments.
This effectively allows you to cast spells beyond the typical 10-glyph limit.
eqpack.quest.spellcasting.inscription_ta: §9Iron's Spells and Spellbooks§r gives you access to highly-specialized combat magic! Amp up your spell power and take on mobs and bosses with spells fine-tuned to hit them at their weakest!

Begin your spellcasting journey with the inscription table by placing your §9spell book§r in the book slot, §nor§r by interacting with the inscription table with your §9spell book§r in the spell book §9curio slot§r to begin filling it with spells.
Place a §9scroll§r in the slot below the spell book, click on the §9spell slot§r you wish to use, then click the §9quill and ink button§r to assign the spell to that slot.
Retrieve the scroll from the table to remove it from the book.
eqpack.quest.spellcasting.novice_spell_b: To begin constructing spells, §5open§r the spell book by pressing §5"C"§r (by default). This will give you access to all your learned glyphs. Glyphs come in three types: §5form§r, §5effect§r, and §5augment§r.
A spell must first be given a form, followed by the desired effects. Both the form and effects can be augmented in various ways.
Press §5"V"§r (by default) to quick-select your spells.
eqpack.quest.spellcasting.ritual_brazier: To perform a ritual, you will need a §5ritual brazier§r and a §5tablet§r to define the ritual.
Use the tablet on the brazier to light the brazier. Once lit, you may add §5augmenting items§r by tossing them onto the brazier. Some rituals require §5source§r to operate.
Activate the ritual by interacting with the brazier with an empty hand.
eqpack.quest.spellcasting.runic_chalk.de: Used to place runes which can be inscribed with a §5spell parchment.§r
The rune will cast its inscribed spell on any entity that treads upon it.
§5Ars Nouveau§r is your one-stop-shop for automation magic! The unique spell-building mechanic allows you to combine §5glyphs§r in multitudes of ways, limiting you only by your creativity!
To begin, interact with the scribe's table with spell book in-hand. This will grant you the ability to create glyphs.

Select the glyph you wish to craft and §5toss the required ingredients§r onto the table. The scribe's table will also §5automatically§r pull from nearby inventories if the required items are available. Using the dominion wand on the table will disable this.
Once crafted, use the §5glyph§r to learn it.
eqpack.quest.spellcasting.scroll_forge.d: Combine magic ink, paper, and the appropriate spell focus to create §9new spell scrolls!§r
Each §9school of magic§r requires a specific item to access its spells.
Higher-level ink will produce higher-level spells.
eqpack.quest.spellcasting.shriving_stone: Easily remove imbued spells from your weapons by combining them with a §9shriving stone§r in the arcane anvil. This will §nnot§r return the scroll.
You can also use the shriving stone to remove §9upgrade orbs§r from your equipment, returning the orbs to you.
eqpack.quest.spellcasting.upgrade_orb.de: Used to create upgrade orbs capable of giving your gear mighty powers! Combine with armor or weapons in the §9arcane anvil§r. You can do this up to 3 times to grant greater effects!
eqpack.quest.spellcasting.wand.title: Wand
eqpack.quest.spellcasting.wand.descripti: Can be inscribed with a spell at the inscription table.
The enchanter's wand always casts §5projectile --> accellerate§r as it's initial form and augment. When building your spell, simply continue from this point, adding §nonly§r effects and augments.
This effectively allows you to cast spells beyond the typical 10-glyph limit.

eqpack.quest.storage.bundles.description: a whole stack of different kind of items inside

eqpack.quest.storage.crate.description.0: Perfect for all sorts of junk

You dont need any explanation do you?

eqpack.chapter.tier_1.title: Tier 1 - Basic Magic
eqpack.quest.tier_1.aoe_tools.title: AOE Tools
eqpack.quest.tier_1.aoe_tools.descriptio: Hammers act like pickaxes, but mine a 3x3.
Excavators act like shovels, but mine a 3x3.
eqpack.quest.tier_1.bamboo_basket.title: Bamboo Basket
eqpack.quest.tier_1.bamboo_basket.descri: The basket picks up items from the block space next to its open side! They can be placed in any direction.
eqpack.quest.tier_1.basic_automation_mat: You'll want to automate that, for sure.
eqpack.quest.tier_1.basic_entity_transpo: Most basic item transportation aside from water channels.
Items need to be put on the Luminizer Launcher to be transported through the luminizer connections.
Use wand of the forest to connect Luminizers by shift-rightclicking.
Right click a Luminizer to be transported through connections.
eqpack.quest.tier_1.basic_tier_upgrade.d: Adds sophisticated functionality to the barrel or chest. Also allows for further upgrades of the storage space.
eqpack.quest.tier_1.basic_to_copper_tier: Be sure to check for other upgrades available from §cSophisticated Storage!§r They'll come in handy along the way for more storage and automation options.
eqpack.quest.tier_1.blast_furnace_booste: Placing Armorer's Aid on top of a Blast Furnace sometimes makes it output more ingots from smelting raw ore
eqpack.quest.tier_1.bottled_cloud.title: Bottled Cloud
eqpack.quest.tier_1.bottled_cloud.descri: Right click in the air between y=190 and y=320 to trap a cloud in a bottle.
This isn't the only time you are gonna have to craft stuff at high altitudes so you should probably build some infrastructure around it.
Below you are going to find a quest that sells you materials to make your very own makeshift cloud elevator!
eqpack.quest.tier_1.brown_shulker_box.de: Shulker Boxes now cheaper than ever
Sack to shulker box recipe keeps its inventory!
eqpack.quest.tier_1.bucket.title: Bucket
eqpack.quest.tier_1.bucket.description.1: You know how to use a bucket, don't you?
eqpack.quest.tier_1.buy_a_map_to_the_lus: Buy a Map to the Lush Caves
Getting to the §l§2Lush Caves§r§r is crucial for the progression of the next chapter!
You can buy map to this biome for just §e4 gold coins!§r
eqpack.quest.tier_1.coal_coke_production: You may find yourself needing a §omassive§r amount of coal coke later on.
§4From now on you will lose hunger on death.§r§r
eqpack.quest.tier_1.cog_block.title: Cog Block
eqpack.quest.tier_1.cog_block.descriptio: Can move power up and down. Does not need a block to support it.
eqpack.quest.tier_1.copper_spell_book.de: With the help of an Inscription Table, the Flimsy Journal will open up the world of offensive and defensive magic!
eqpack.quest.tier_1.crafting_station.des: The §5§lCrafting Station§r§r can pull items from inventories adjacent to all 6 of its sides!
eqpack.quest.tier_1.crumbling_altar.desc: Build a§2§l Natural Altar§r§r multiblock with the crumbling catalyst to grind a bit of gold dust.
Be careful! Draining too much Aura from an area may have unwanted consequences.
If this makes you nervous, you can use Create's millstone as a safer, manual alternative.
Catalyst goes on top of one of the lower gem blocks.
eqpack.quest.tier_1.device_composter.des: Works like a regular composter but composts 9 items at a time.
The result will be compost instead of bone meal.
eqpack.quest.tier_1.device_fisher.title: Device Fisher
eqpack.quest.tier_1.device_fisher.descri: The loot table is quite different from regular fishing.
eqpack.quest.tier_1.diamond_heart.title: Diamond Heart
eqpack.quest.tier_1.diamond_heart.descri: To get §l§bHeart of Diamond§r§r you need to sneak up to a §l§8stoneling§r§r and kill it.
Stonelings can be found in dark caves and are easily spooked. They'll disappear if they survive your first blow.
Stoneling have 8 health points and they are weak to arcane damage but take less damage from blood and nature damage
eqpack.quest.tier_1.dispenser.title: Dispenser
eqpack.quest.tier_1.dispenser.descriptio: Dispenser can now place blocks, plant seeds and more!
eqpack.quest.tier_1.fermenting_jar.title: Fermenting Jar
eqpack.quest.tier_1.fermenting_jar.descr: New food types! Not to mention the other things it'll craft...
eqpack.quest.tier_1.find_an_amethyst_geo: Right clicking with a §5§lDowsing Rod§r§r will highlight §5§lAmethyst§r§r-related blocks near you.
eqpack.quest.tier_1.first_fluid_transpor: The §8§lfaucet§r§r can drain fluid out from the side of one container into another container placed below it!
eqpack.quest.tier_1.first_magical_feat.d: If you can't even do that, are you sure you want to keep playing?
To craft a furnace you are going to need 8 sturdy stones and 1 coal block.
eqpack.quest.tier_1.glass.title: Glass
eqpack.quest.tier_1.glass.description.1: Glass not only looks nice, it is also needed for various crafting recipes.
eqpack.quest.tier_1.imbuement_chamber.de: Insert the item to be transformed by right clicking, or by some other means of item transport, such as a hopper.
Automation will require filters, as a simple hopper will pull the item before crafting is completed.
While §bSource§r is not necessary for full function, it will greatly speed up the process.
eqpack.quest.tier_1.lightning_bottle.des: You can craft it by exploding a cloud in a bottle and a lightning rod between §4§ly=180 and y=210§r§r.
Or you could just right click a charged creeper with an empty bottle.
eqpack.quest.tier_1.lightning_crafting.d: Works exactly like explosion crafting except with lightning.
There are a few ways to accomplish this.
You can even wait for a thunderstorm with a lightning rod! But that may take a while...
eqpack.quest.tier_1.light_staff.title: Light Staff
eqpack.quest.tier_1.light_staff.descript: Uses aura from your aura cache to create light on right click!
eqpack.quest.tier_1.millstone.title: Millstone
eqpack.quest.tier_1.millstone.descriptio: Grind a bit of §6gold dust.§r Grind a lot, if you have the energy to crank a few millstones at once!
§o§7Note that watermills no longer generate stress units, though they will still power blocks like belts and weighted ejectors.§r§r
eqpack.quest.tier_1.new_tools.title: New Tools
eqpack.quest.tier_1.new_tools.descriptio: §cCopper Tools§r are extremely durable and are able to mine higher-tier ores than stone tools.
§8Iron Tools§r are not as durable, but gain some reach and are faster than copper tools.
§7Silver Tools§r are the most brittle of the tools at this level. In exchange, they are fastest at this stage and give the user a movement speed boost!
§9Lead Tools§r are similar to iron in durability and mining speed, but also gain knockback resistance and have the highest mining lvl at this tier.
§6Bronze Tools§r are the most durable of the tools at this level. With the same mining lvl as lead, bronze is also imbued with natural Vein Mining.
eqpack.quest.tier_1.oak_generator.title: Oak Generator
eqpack.quest.tier_1.oak_generator.descri: Ever wished you could control those pesky giant oak trees in your tree farm?
The §6Canopy Diminisher§r converts excess growth energy from tall oak trees into Aura, replenishing the surrounding area while preventing the oaks from growing too tall.
eqpack.quest.tier_1.phytogenic_insolator: Very slow but does not require much setup.
Only works with sky access and during the day
eqpack.quest.tier_1.placer.title: Placer
eqpack.quest.tier_1.placer.description.1: Remember to unclaim your chunks if you want this to work
eqpack.quest.tier_1.plates.title: Plates
eqpack.quest.tier_1.plates.description.1: To get plates, smash §lTreated Wood Planks§r and §lSmooth Stone§r with an §lEngineer's Hammer§r.
eqpack.quest.tier_1.plate_automation.des: You can automate the creation of plates with an anvil falling on treated wood planks or smooth stone!
eqpack.quest.tier_1.redstone_innovations: Now that you can craft redstone torches, a lot of cool stuff opens up!
eqpack.quest.tier_1.return_scroll.title: Return Scroll
eqpack.quest.tier_1.return_scroll.descri: The return scroll will return you to your respawn point when used. It is consumed on use.
eqpack.quest.tier_1.sawmill.title: Sawmill
Craft a saw and submit an empty sack to get a new sack with some goodies inside!
eqpack.quest.tier_1.shears.title: Shears
eqpack.quest.tier_1.slay_the_naga.title: Slay the Naga
eqpack.quest.tier_1.slay_the_naga.descri: If you don't like fighting the Twilight Forest bosses, there are ways to synthesize their drops using alchemy!
Check out the §3Alchemy§r quest tab for more info!
eqpack.quest.tier_1.starbuncle_charm.des: The cutest form of item transport!
eqpack.quest.tier_1.stonecutter.title: Stonecutter
eqpack.quest.tier_1.stonecutter.descript: Craft a stonecutter and submit an empty sack to get a new sack with some goodies inside!
eqpack.quest.tier_1.the_fluffiest_elevat: §b§lBlue Aercloud§r§r will launch any player who walks into them high into the air!
Meanwhile, §lCold Aerclouds§r are perfect for safely breaking your fall from a great height.
eqpack.quest.tier_1.thicc_scroll.title: Thicc Scroll
eqpack.quest.tier_1.visit_the_twilight_f: The §5§lDimension Ripper§r§r activates the Twilight Forest portal like a diamond usually would.
The portal needs at least 4 water source blocks with any dirt around it with any flowers on top of the grass.
Maximum size for the portal is 9x9 including the dirt frame.
eqpack.quest.tier_1.wixie_charm.title: Wixie Charm
eqpack.quest.tier_1.wooden_hopper.title: Wooden Hopper
eqpack.quest.tier_1.wooden_hopper.descri: Like regular hoppers but slower and only contain one slot.
eqpack.quest.tier_1.ziplining_through_th: Connect your ropelike items to the walls and hold right click with a zipline attachment item to move around!
eqpack.chapter.tier_2.title: Tier 2 - Basic Elemental Infusion
eqpack.quest.tier_2.air_essence.title: Air Essence
eqpack.quest.tier_2.angel_blessing.title: Angel Blessing
eqpack.quest.tier_2.arcane_crafting.desc: With the help of the §5§lEnchanting Apparatus§r§r, you can craft tons of new items!
You can now access enchanting, as well... if you've found some enchanting runes.
§5The Enchanting Apparatus can enchant §nany§r §5compatible item! Not just books!§r
eqpack.quest.tier_2.aura_generator_block: The §2Aura Generator BLock§r is a necessary component of higher-tier Aura generation.
eqpack.quest.tier_2.base_of_the_generato: Crafting the §5§lMagical Generator Block§r§r might look complicated at first, but don't be afraid!
Just hold "W" while hovering over the item to watch a §2ponder§r about the craft.
eqpack.quest.tier_2.better_aoe_tools.des: Upgrade your AOE tools to increase their AOE range, double their durability and increase their speed by over 60%%!
eqpack.quest.tier_2.blazing_core.title: Blazing Core
eqpack.quest.tier_2.capturing_gem.title: Capturing Gem
eqpack.quest.tier_2.diamond_equipment.de: §bDiamond tools§r are the most durable of the tools available in this tier, with over 2k durability!
They also have the highest mining lvl.
eqpack.quest.tier_2.distilling_the_eleme: Mastering the elements is a crucial part of any magic-user's journey.
Placing the appropriate items into the §9Elemental Evaporator§r will allow you to extract the elements in their liquid forms.
Or you can place §9Elemental Extractor§r equipped with §9Elemental Pump§r to achieve the same result
eqpack.quest.tier_2.earth_essence.title: Earth Essence
eqpack.quest.tier_2.elemental_arcanum.de: Arcanum can be infused with elemental fluid, yielding a crystalized form of the element which can then be used in crafting.
eqpack.quest.tier_2.elemental_core.title: Elemental Core
eqpack.quest.tier_2.elytra.title: Elytra
eqpack.quest.tier_2.elytra.description.0: I feel like I can glide!
eqpack.quest.tier_2.feeding_trough.title: Feeding Trough
eqpack.quest.tier_2.feeding_trough.descr: Automatically feeds the animals around it when supplied with their preferred food. Not as efficient as feeding them yourself!
Like the golden magic feather, the §4firey magic feather§r will insta-mine obsidian with a right click. However, it has §omuch§r more durability.
eqpack.quest.tier_2.fire_essence.title: Fire Essence
eqpack.quest.tier_2.golden_magic_feather: With the power of the §6Golden Magic Feather§r you can mine obsidian instantly by right clicking!
Be careful, though! It doesn't have much durability.
eqpack.quest.tier_2.golem_heart.title: Golem Heart
eqpack.quest.tier_2.infused_iron.title: Infused Iron
eqpack.quest.tier_2.infused_iron.descrip: Infusing iron with Aura is one of the first critical steps in magical crafting.
eqpack.quest.tier_2.infusion_catalyst.de: You'll need the power of the §aInfusion Catalyst§r in the Natural Altar to infuse mundane materials with magical properties!
eqpack.quest.tier_2.kiln_alloy_smelter.d: As you can see you will need a lot of essences to craft the whole Kiln.
You might be tempted to bite the bullet and do it by hand but you will need much more in the future so it might be a good time to automate the basic essences.
This multiblock requires specific fire related magic fuel.
Check the uses for the alloy kiln to display how to build it correctly
eqpack.quest.tier_2.magical_ore_doubling: Doesn't need Soul Core like EMI might suggest
eqpack.quest.tier_2.magic_machine.title: Magic Machine
eqpack.quest.tier_2.magic_machine.descri: Does the machine make the magic? Or is it the magic that makes the machine?
eqpack.quest.tier_2.manasteel_ingot.desc: Your first ingots of §5Source Alloy§r must be made with the inefficient tree ritual recipe.
At the end of the chapter, you will unlock a much better method.
eqpack.quest.tier_2.mana_spreader.title: Mana Spreader
eqpack.quest.tier_2.nature_essence.title: Nature Essence
eqpack.quest.tier_2.nature_essence.descr: To create §l§aNature Essence§r§r you need to toss the ingredients into water located in a Lush Caves biome.
What?! You don't know where the Lush Caves are? Buy a map to the biome from the quest in the previous chapter!
eqpack.quest.tier_2.new_and_improved_gol: §6Gold tools§r have been completely reworked! Still faster than diamond, the durability has been increased significantly and the mining lvl is now the same as iron.
Most importantly: Gold tools are imbued with natural §6Fortune 2§r and the sword with natural §6Looting 2§r.
eqpack.quest.tier_2.new_equipment_opport: Zinc makes a much more durable tool handle, necessary to make §bdiamond§r and §6gold§r tools.
eqpack.quest.tier_2.ocean_stone.title: Ocean Stone
eqpack.quest.tier_2.ruby_brazier.title: Ruby Brazier
eqpack.quest.tier_2.schematicannon.title: Schematicannon
eqpack.quest.tier_2.skyjade.title: Skyjade
Infusing emeralds with Aura unlocks new tools and armor!
eqpack.quest.tier_2.skyjade_tools.title: Skyjade Tools
eqpack.quest.tier_2.skyjade_tools.descri: §2Skyjade tools§r have the same range as iron and double the durability. They lose effectiveness as durability decreases.
Both the §2Skyjade sword and axe§r deal extra §eholy damage§r making them excellent weapons against the undead.
The §2Skyjade sword§r deals massive amounts of damage at the cost of attack speed. It also loses attack damage as the durability goes down.
eqpack.quest.tier_2.source_alloy_equipme: §9Source Alloy Tools§r are similiar in strength to iron equipment but they have the ability to self repair using source from your source tablet
eqpack.quest.tier_2.source_generators.de: Pulling magic out of the world...
The §5§lEnchanting Apparatus§r§r uses source for many crafting recipes. Craft one of the source generators, as well as a source jar to produce and store your source!
eqpack.quest.tier_2.storage_network.desc: §b§lCorporea Network§r§r needs a single §b§lMaster Corporea Spark§r§r to function.
Place sparks on top of inventories to connect them.
Note that §b§lMaster Corporea Spark§r§r will not see anything in the inventory it is attatched to.

To use §b§lCorporea Index§r§r connect it with a system using a spark walk into its range and type in chat whatever you want to withdraw from your system. Alternatively you can press §lC§r while hovering over an item.
eqpack.quest.tier_2.tainted_gold.title: Tainted Gold
eqpack.quest.tier_2.tainted_gold.descrip: Regular gold is good for some things, but to progress with magical crafting, we must use magical ingredients.
Aura-infused §6tainted gold§r will greatly assist you in your journey.
eqpack.quest.tier_2.the_terraformer.desc: With the power of §2The Terraformer§r you can instantly turn basic stone blocks and dirt-like blocks into compost.
Very nice for shaping the terrain around your base.
eqpack.quest.tier_2.visit_the_nether.des: Upon entering §4The Nether§r you will want to find and slay some blazes. Their rods will be very useful for further creation of magical machines.
eqpack.quest.tier_2.warp_scroll.title: Warp Scroll
eqpack.quest.tier_2.water_essence.title: Water Essence
eqpack.quest.tier_2.workstations_on_a_st: You can now access your crafting stations from your inventory by right clicking the crafting station on a stick in your hand. Or set a keybind for the Curio slot!
eqpack.quest.tier_2.zanite_gemstone.desc: Infusing diamonds with Aura unlocks new tools and armor!
eqpack.quest.tier_2.zanite_tools.title: Zanite Tools
eqpack.quest.tier_2.zanite_tools.descrip: §5Zanite tools§r reach 0.5 blocks farther than iron with double the durability.
§5Zanite tools§r also mine faster the lower their durability gets.
The sword deals the same damage as iron, but most of its damage is converted to §eholy damage§r which makes it a perfect weapon against the §4undead§r.
eqpack.chapter.tier_3.title: Tier 3 - Primitive Tech
§4§lEverything after this point is extremely unfinished and will most likely be completely changed!§r§r
eqpack.quest.tier_3.andesite_alloy.title: Andesite Alloy
eqpack.quest.tier_3.andesite_alloy.descr: §7Andesite Alloy§r is a unique material used in the crafting of automation materials and machines. You'll definitely want to stock up!
eqpack.quest.tier_3.arcane_gold_ingot.de: §6Arcane Gold§r is a powerful magical resource. Building up a good supply will benefit you greatly.
eqpack.quest.tier_3.arcane_iterator.desc: Using items from nearby pedestals, the §6Arcane Iterator§r takes wissen, health, and experience to create §5Enchantment Runes§r or to enchant §6Arcane Tools.§r
eqpack.quest.tier_3.controller.title: Controller
eqpack.quest.tier_3.controller.descripti: The storage controller and storage tool will give you even more control of your Sophisticated Storages. Use the Storage Lectern from Ars Nouveau to gain access to all connected inventories at once!
eqpack.quest.tier_3.dark_essence.title: Dark Essence
eqpack.quest.tier_3.death_essence.title: Death Essence
eqpack.quest.tier_3.deployer.title: Deployer
eqpack.quest.tier_3.elemental_binder.des: Higher-level magical crafting will require more than simple elemental essences.
The §9Elemental Binder§r will allow you to combine materials to form more complex elemental essences.
eqpack.quest.tier_3.ender_essence.title: Ender Essence
eqpack.quest.tier_3.life_essence.title: Life Essence
eqpack.quest.tier_3.light_essence.title: Light Essence
eqpack.quest.tier_3.rainbow_magic_feathe: With the same obsidian-breaking powers of the other magic feathers, the §5Rainbow Magic Feather§r will also break the bedrock of the Nether Roof!
eqpack.quest.tier_3.redstone_core.title: Redstone Core
eqpack.quest.tier_3.redstone_core.descri: The §4Redstone Core§r is a powerful crafting component which will open up many new automation opportunities!
eqpack.quest.tier_3.spawn_lamp.title: Spawn Lamp
eqpack.quest.tier_3.stress_unit_generato: In this pack you can only heat up boilers with blaze burners.
For many processes going forward, you are going to need to generate §cstress units§r. Steam engines will give you access to this crucial energy source!
eqpack.chapter.weaponry_owner.title: Bladesmith
eqpack.chapter.welcome.title: Welcome - Information Dump
eqpack.chapter.welcome.decoration.2.tool: Take a look at the CurseForge website
eqpack.chapter.welcome.decoration.3.tool: BTW, the pack is open source
eqpack.quest.welcome.balanced_diet.title: Balanced Diet
eqpack.quest.welcome.balanced_diet.descr: This modpack uses both Spice of Life: Onion and Carrot Editions.
§6§lCarrot Edition§r gives additional hearts. You get your first extra heart after eating 5 new foods, then after every 25 new foods.

§l§eOnion Edition§r§r, instead, depends on how diverse and nutritious your diet is, so eating bigger meals and cycling between different foods will get you extra buffs, such as extra reach, movement speed, resistances, and extra hearts.
It is set up in a way that it only takes a bit of effort to be as strong as a regular player.
eqpack.quest.welcome.cursed_mode.title: Cursed Mode
eqpack.quest.welcome.cursed_mode.descrip: Not for the Faint at Heart
§4§lTHIS IS NOT RECOMMENDED FOR A FIRST PLAYTHROUGH§r§r
You've found a ring with a strange, dark allure...
Energy courses through your body as it slips on your finger, rendering you sleepless evermore.
As you venture out, you realize — everything and everyone wants you dead. Every wound cuts twice as deep.
There's no telling what all this trinket has done to you.
Wearing the Cursed Ring adds special drops to the mobs:
Elder Guardian - Extra Prismarine Shards and Crystals, Guardian Heart, Heart of the Sea, Enchanted Golden Apple, Ender Eye, Trident
Zombified Piglin - Extra Gold Ingots, Glowstone Dust
Wither Skeleton - Blaze Powder, Ghast Tear, Netherite Scrap
I want to have a hard time!
eqpack.quest.welcome.market.title: Market
You can buy some useful stuff in the Market tab. It might be overpriced, but if you really need something...
eqpack.quest.welcome.nerfed_player.title: Nerfed Player
eqpack.quest.welcome.nerfed_player.descr: As you may or may not have realized, many player attributes have been nerfed, including:
Choose a custom totem to negate one of those nerfs.
Totems are new items custom-made for the pack. They give special effects when held in the offhand. Search §d"@druidic"§r in EMI to check out more custom stuff!
eqpack.quest.welcome.options_and_keybind: The pack comes with assigned keybinds so there are no conflicts, but you'll want to set your own in many cases.
Most are actually unset, and familiar keybinds can really benefit your gameplay.
eqpack.quest.welcome.progression_chapter: The Progression chapter is essential to not get lost in all the new things this modpack implements. It will also provide you with some nice rewards!

§2§lGear§r §r-  Quests outside of the Main progression that unlock quests in other chapters (usually in the Market).
§2§lDiamond§r§r - Repeteable Quests, usually giving some nice items in exchange for currency.
§2§lPentagon§r§r - One-time purchases; exchange coins for rare and useful items.
